subject: [Invite] Encord's CVPR AI Leaders Fireside Chat & Dinner - 06/14
text:
Hi [NAME], 

If you're around for CVPR, I'd love to personally invite you to a small dinner we're hosting for a group of AI leaders on 06/14.

We'll kick off with a fireside chat featuring Luc Vincent (former VP of AI at Meta, now Chief R&D Officer at Nexar), followed by a relaxed dinner and conversation with guests from Captions, Woven by Toyota, Pickle Robot, and other leading AI/ML teams.

Here are the details:
Date & Time: Saturday, June 14 at 6:30 PM Location: Moto Cucina (a 15-minute walk from the CVPR venue) Guests: A select group of ~20 CTOs, Heads of AI, and Founders from top AI teams. Confirmed attendees include leaders from Captions, Woven by Toyota, and Pickle Robot. This is an invite-only event for Encord partners and selected AI/ML scale-ups - we hope for it to be a relaxed evening for exchanging ideas, not a sales pitch. If you're not familiar with Encord: we're a data development platform helping 200+ AI teams - including Synthesia, Hudl, and Woven by Toyota - bring better models to market, faster.

Would you be interested in joining us?

subject: Working w/ ElevenLabs & Soundhound | Aura-2
text:
Hi [NAME],​

I just read about Aura-2's low-latency performance & thought I'd reach out. I lead a Conversational AI team here at Encord (~6 years old, 100+ employees & $50M+ funding) - we're actually working with a few of your peers (Synthesia, ElevenLabs, Captions, Soundhound, etc) on developing new models / improving existing ones for use cases like ASR, TTS, STT, NER, etc. 

For context, I met some of your colleagues at NVIDA GTC who mentioned that it might be interesting to get connected. Keen to trade notes & get your thoughts on what we're building here if you have 15 mins to chat over the coming weeks? I'm usually open Thursday / Friday.

subject: Data Development at Verana Qdata | Working with FlatIron & TargetRWE
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

Saw your recent focus on data development & quality as you integrate more complex clinical data, thought I'd reach out.

I've recently been working with Flatiron Health and TargetRWE who were in a similar position as they looked to streamline data curation and annotation workflows to enhance regulatory compliance and efficiency in handling unstructured data (EHRs, PDFs, DICOM etc). Our platform's integration and automation capabilities improved interoperability, offering a future-proof solution for managing multimodal data across their operations.

Would be keen to trade notes and get your thoughts on what we're building - open to a 30-minute chat this or next week?

Saw your recent focus on data development & quality as you integrate more complex clinical data, thought I'd reach out.

I've recently been working with Flatiron Health and TargetRWE who were in a similar position as they looked to streamline data curation and annotation workflows to enhance regulatory compliance and efficiency in handling unstructured data (EHRs, PDFs, DICOM etc). Our platform's integration and automation capabilities improved interoperability, offering a future-proof solution for managing multimodal data across their operations.

Would be keen to trade notes and get your thoughts on what we're building - open to a 30-minute chat this or next week?
